LESSON: RAISING THE WIDOW’S SON

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: Raising the Widow’s Son

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Raising the Widow’s Son. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to believe in the resurrection of the dead as a Christian?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: RAISING THE WIDOW’S SON
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Raising the Widow’s Son helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: RAISING THE WIDOW’S SON
Study Raising the Widow’s Son like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ

What this means
In this part you learn to model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Raising the Widow’s Son” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Raising the Widow’s Son is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Raising the Widow’s Son” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Raising the Widow’s Son to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Raising the Widow’s Son from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Raising the Widow’s Son: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Raising the Widow’s Son?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to believe in the resurrection of the dead as a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Raising the Widow’s Son means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
